config.dynamicoutlines.title: Dynamic Outlines
config.dynamicoutlines.missing_tool_visi: Controls the Non-Interactive outline when breaking the block wouldn't give you anything: always show it, always hide it, or hide it unless you're holding a block (useful for placement).
config.dynamicoutlines.stroke_width.tool: Controls how thick block and entity outlines are drawn.
config.dynamicoutlines.outline_alpha.too: Global transparency for all block and entity outlines.
config.dynamicoutlines.block_outline_mod: Choose which blocks get outlined: none, only interactive blocks, only non-interactive blocks, or all blocks.
config.dynamicoutlines.interactive_color: Outline color used for any interactive block.
config.dynamicoutlines.noninteractive_co: Outline color used for ordinary blocks.
config.dynamicoutlines.entity_outline_mo: Choose which entities get outlined: none, passive/neutral/hostile entities, entities you can interact with, or all entities.
config.dynamicoutlines.entity_color.tool: Outline color used when targeting a passive or neutral entity.
config.dynamicoutlines.enemy_color.toolt: Outline color used when targeting a hostile entity.
config.dynamicoutlines.entity_interactio: Overrides an entity's outline color when you're holding an item that unlocks a special interaction with it.
